pick.headline: Baker and Shevardnadze issue a joint statement condemning Iraq

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 150, 3 August 1990
evidence.snippet: FBIS-SOV-90-150 3 August 1990 Baker will meet Soviet Foreign Minister Eduard She- vardnadze, after which he will leave for Washington, according to a report by the U.S. State Department. U.S. President Decries Iraqi Invasion of Kuwait LD0208 195690 Moscow…
